definitions.utilization: Share of the window's hours with repository work by the agent: a pull request opened, a commit pushed to one, or one merged.
definitions.error_rate: Not published. Review verdicts are withheld, so the page shows a dash rather than a failure rate.
definitions.efficiency: Median hours from a pull request opened to merged (hours, not a percent).
definitions.attribution: A pull request belongs to the agent whose branch prefix it came from.
definitions.scope: Public totals can be refreshed. This snapshot's hours are the last measured window. Review verdicts and private titles are not published.
